free_tier.stated: A newly launched Chinese-language merchant that issues free NAT VPS instances to new registrants, one in Japan and one in the United States, with renewal driven by coupons announced in its Telegram group rather than by a published free plan. A community user reports the pair as 有一台日本一台美国的，后续应该是免费续费的, quoted.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A free NAT instance in Tokyo plus a free DNS-fronted tunnel is a complete always-on origin for a scraper at zero cost; the NAT port mapping is what limits inbound services.

limits.value: The free term is only as long as the next coupon, and the coupons are distributed in a Telegram group, so the machine survives by following an announcement channel. The terms add that no data is guaranteed after expiry and that no refund is given for any reason, so an unrenewed box loses its data silently.

notes: New to the corpus: no HostSlate record exists. The storefront returned 200 with 36 words and no price body because the catalogue is rendered client-side; a crawl of five pages recovered the signup form and the terms but no price table, so there is no price for this provider in this record and none was estimated. The two forum threads carry the free-instance claim. The class this represents is the one the wave brief asked for: a merchant months old giving hardware away to build a user base, where the risk is that it stops, and the terms say out loud that a lapse loses the data.
